title: Tokenized Tesla surges as Elon Musk unveils SpaceX-powered flying Roadster prototype
summary: Volume in Hyperliquid’s Tesla contract hit $47 million in one hour after Elon Musk’s flying Roadster demo, up from $2.8 million, with U.S. stocks closed.

title: Ripple Prime adds RWA swaps referencing perpetual futures listed on Hyperliquid
summary: Ripple Prime has added RWA perpetual swaps tied to equities, ETFs, metals, energy and currencies, with 24/7 trading and settlement.
